newsitem.title: UK: Europe buys most Iraq crude as SOMO nears target.
newsitem.headline: Europe buys most Iraq crude as SOMO nears target.

text.p: European refiners are set to absorb the lion's share of renewed Iraqi oil sales as Baghdad closed easily this week on 500,000 barrels a day (bpd) of export contracts, oil traders said on Thursday.
Europe is also likely to see shortly the first spot sale of Iraqi crude in six years since U.N. sanctions were imposed for Baghdad's invasion of Kuwait.
Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organisation (SOMO) had by Thursday signed 16 contracts worth a combined 435,000 bpd.
Four more contracts totalling 65,000 bpd, three with Russian firms and one with a European company, were in the pipeline,
